ko.title: 두 해협, 하나의 교통 요충지: 후티 반군은 어떻게 바브엘만데브 해로를 통제하게 되었는가

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## 홍해의 지도를 새로 그린 일주일

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: 일주일 남짓한 기간 동안 친이란 후티 반군은 급격한 군사 작전을 완료하여 홍해와 아덴만을 연결하고 수에즈 운하로 이어지는 좁은 수로인 바브엘만데브 해협의 예멘 측 지역을 실질적으로 통제하게 되었습니다.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: 공세는 9월 3일 타이즈시와 모카 항구를 연결하는 도로를 끊기 위한 진격으로 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: 며칠 만에 후티 부대는 모카, 두밥 마을, 그리고 해협 입구 근처의 전략적 요충지인 마이윤섬을 점령했습니다.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: 이후 정부군은 바브엘만데브를 두 개의 운항 가능한 항로로 나누는 전초 기지인 페림섬에서 철수하여 후티 반군에게 두 수로 모두에 대한 통제권을 넘겨주었습니다.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: 후티 그룹은 더 북쪽에 있는 대하니스섬과 소하니스섬까지 점령하며 해협의 주요 거점에 대한 통제를 완결지었습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## 이 해협이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: 바브엘만데브는 세계에서 가장 중요한 해상 교통 요충지 중 하나로, 유럽 및 그 너머로 향하는 대량의 걸프만 석유 수출을 포함하여 수에즈 운하를 통과하는 해상 물동량의 상당 부분을 담당하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: 해협의 예멘 해안선을 통제함으로써 후티 반군과 그들을 지원하는 테헤란 당국은 홍해 연안국과 글로벌 해운사들이 의존하는 해로에 대해 영향력을 행사할 수 있게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 타이밍이 특히 의미심장하다고 지적합니다. 이번 성과는 전 세계 해상 석유 이동량의 상당 부분이 통과하는 아라비아반도 반대편 수로인 호르무즈 해협에 대해 이란이 압박을 지속하는 가운데 이루어졌습니다.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: 두 개의 교통 요충지를 합쳐 친이란 세력은 아라비아반도 양쪽 측면의 해상 경로에 영향력을 행사하게 되었으며, 이는 에너지 시장과 지역 정부 모두를 불안하게 만든 변화입니다.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## 후티의 보장과 지역의 불안감

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: 후티 정치국의 한 고위 관리는 국제 해운 회사들과 지역 정부들을 안심시키기 위해 후티 그룹이 홍해 화물 운송에 "아무런 위험이 되지 않는다"며 "홍해와 바브엘만데브에서의 항해의 자유와 국제 무역은 안전하고 질서 있게 유지되고 있다"고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: 이웃 국가들과 해상 보험사들은 이 회랑을 통한 운송에 차질이 생기는지 주시하면서 지금까지 이러한 보장에 대해 신중한 태도를 취해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: 후티 전사들은 현재 해협의 아프리카 측 근처에 배치된 것으로 보고되고 있으며, 이는 후티 그룹이 이 요충지의 접근로를 얼마나 단단히 쥐고 있는지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## 인간적인 대가

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: 이 작전은 예멘 민간인들에게 큰 대가를 치르게 했습니다.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: 구호 관계자들은 일주일간의 전투로 수백 명이 사망하고 수만 명이 집을 잃었으며, 유엔 이주기구(IOM)는 폭력 사태로 인해 약 46,000명의 피란민이 발생한 것으로 추정하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: 전선이 이동함에 따라 인도주의 단체들은 피해를 입은 해안 지역사회에 대한 접근을 요구하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: 영토 통제권의 변화에도 불구하고 바브엘만데브를 통한 선박 이동이 계속됨에 따라 해운 및 에너지 시장은 급격히 반응하기보다는 사태를 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: 그러나 후티 측 보장의 지속성, 걸프 국가들과 서방 해군의 대응, 그리고 더 넓은 지역 분쟁의 전반적인 궤적에 따라 이것이 지구상에서 가장 붐비는 무역로 중 하나에 대한 영향력 주체의 영구적인 변화가 될지, 아니면 홍해 남쪽 관문을 둘러싼 더 긴 투쟁의 서막이 될지가 결정될 것입니다.

zh.title: 两处海峡，一处咽喉：胡塞武装如何控制曼德海峡航线

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## 一周重绘红海地图

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: 在短短一周多时间内，伊朗支持的胡塞武装完成了一场迅速的军事行动，使其实际上控制了也门一侧的曼德海峡——这条狭窄的水道将红海与亚丁湾之间的航运汇聚起来，并进一步通往苏伊士运河。

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: 这场攻势始于9月3日，当时他们发起进攻，切断了连接塔伊兹市与穆哈港的道路。

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: 几天之内，胡塞武装就攻占了穆哈、杜巴布镇以及位于海峡入海口附近的战略要地米永岛。

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: 随后，政府军从将曼德海峡分为两条可航行水道的前哨岛——丕林岛撤出，将海峡两侧的控制权交给了胡塞武装。

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: 该组织随后占领了更北面的大哈尼什岛和小哈尼什岛，巩固了其对海峡关键航点的控制。

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么海峡如此重要

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: 曼德海峡是世界上最重要的海上咽喉要道之一，承载了原本将通过苏伊士运河的大部分航运流量，其中包括大量运往欧洲及其他地区的波斯湾石油出口。

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: 控制海峡的也门海岸线赋予了胡塞武装（从而也赋予了他们在德黑兰的支持者）对红海国家和全球航运公司赖以生存的航线的施压能力。

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，此时机尤为敏感：这些进展正值伊朗维持对霍尔木兹海峡的施压之际，该海峡位于阿拉伯半岛的另一侧，全球很大一部分海运石油经此通过。

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: 这两个咽喉要道共同赋予了伊朗支持的武装力量对半岛两侧海上路线的影响力，这一发展令能源市场和地区政府都感到不安。

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## 胡塞武装的保证与地区的焦虑

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: 胡塞武装政治局的一位高级官员试图让国际航运公司和地区政府放心，称该组织对红海货运流量“没有危险”，“红海和曼德海峡的航行自由和国际贸易是安全有序的”。

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: 周边国家和航运保险公司迄今对这些保证持谨慎态度，密切关注该走廊过境运输的任何中断。

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: 据报道，胡塞武装战斗人员现在已经部署在靠近海峡非洲一侧的地方，这提醒人们该组织现在对咽喉要道接近路线的控制是多么紧密。

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## 人道主义代价

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: 这场军事行动让也门平民付出了沉重的代价。

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: 救援官员表示，一周的战斗已造成数百人死亡，数万人流离失所，联合国移民机构估计暴力冲突导致约46000人流离失所。

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: 随着前线推移，人道主义组织正呼吁允许进入受影响的沿海社区。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: 目前，航运和能源市场正密切关注而非急剧反应，因为尽管领土控制权发生了变化，但通过曼德海峡的船只运动仍在继续。

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: 但胡塞武装保证的持久性、海湾国家和西方海军的反应，以及更广泛地区冲突的更广泛轨迹，可能将决定这究竟是成为谁对地球上最繁忙贸易动脉之一拥有影响力的持久转变，还是争夺红海南部大门长期斗争的序幕。

hi.title: दो जलडमरूमध्य, एक घेरा: हूतियों ने बाब अल-मंडेब शिपिंग लेन पर नियंत्रण कैसे हासिल किया

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## एक सप्ताह जिसने लाल सागर का नक्शा बदल दिया

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: एक सप्ताह से कुछ अधिक समय में, ईरान-समर्थित हूती बलों ने एक त्वरित सैन्य अभियान पूरा कर लिया है, जिससे वे बाब अल-मंडेब जलडमरूमध्य के यमनी हिस्से पर प्रभावी नियंत्रण में आ गए हैं — यह वह संकरा जलमार्ग है जो लाल सागर और अदन की खाड़ी के बीच, और आगे स्वेज नहर तक शिपिंग को संचालित करता है।

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: यह आक्रमण 3 सितंबर को ताइज़ शहर को मोखा बंदरगाह से जोड़ने वाली सड़क को काटने के प्रयास के साथ शुरू हुआ।

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: कुछ ही दिनों के भीतर, हूती इकाइयों ने मोखा, धुबाब शहर और जलडमरूमध्य के मुहाने के पास रणनीतिक रूप से स्थित मयून द्वीप पर कब्जा कर लिया।

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: सरकारी बलों ने तब पेरिम द्वीप से वापसी कर ली, जो वह चौकी है जो बाब अल-मंडेब को उसके दो नौगम्य चैनलों में विभाजित करती है, जिससे हूतियों को दोनों मार्गों पर नियंत्रण मिल गया।

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: समूह ने आगे बढ़कर उत्तर में ग्रेटर और लेसर हनिश द्वीपों पर कब्जा कर लिया, जिससे जलडमरूमध्य के प्रमुख बिंदुओं पर उनकी पकड़ मजबूत हो गई।

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## जलडमरूमध्य क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: बाब अल-मंडेब दुनिया के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण समुद्री चोकपॉइंट्स में से एक है, जो उस यातायात का एक बड़ा हिस्सा ले जाता है जो अन्यथा स्वेज नहर से होकर गुजरता, जिसमें यूरोप और उससे आगे जाने वाले खाड़ी तेल निर्यात की एक बड़ी मात्रा शामिल है।

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: जलडमरूमध्य के यमनी तटरेखा पर नियंत्रण हूतियों को — और विस्तार से तेहरान में उनके समर्थकों को — उन शिपिंग लेन पर लाभ देता है जिन पर लाल सागर के देश और वैश्विक वाहक निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों ने नोट किया है कि समय विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है: ये लाभ तब मिले हैं जब ईरान होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य पर दबाव बनाए हुए है, जो अरब प्रायद्वीप के दूसरी तरफ का मार्ग है जिसके माध्यम से दुनिया का एक बड़ा हिस्सा समुद्री तेल का परिवहन करता है।

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: कुल मिलाकर, ये दो चोकपॉइंट्स ईरान-समर्थित बलों को प्रायद्वीप के दोनों किनारों पर समुद्री मार्गों पर प्रभाव देते हैं, एक ऐसा विकास जिसने ऊर्जा बाजारों और क्षेत्रीय सरकारों दोनों को परेशान कर दिया है।

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## हूती आश्वासन, क्षेत्रीय बेचैनी

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: एक वरिष्ठ हूती पोलित ब्यूरो अधिकारी ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय शिपिंग फर्मों और क्षेत्रीय सरकारों को आश्वस्त करने का प्रयास करते हुए कहा कि समूह लाल सागर के कार्गो यातायात के लिए "कोई खतरा" नहीं है और "लाल सागर और बाब अल-मंडेब में नेविगेशन की स्वतंत्रता और अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार सुरक्षित और व्यवस्थित हैं।"

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: पड़ोसी देशों और शिपिंग बीमाकर्ताओं ने अब तक उन आश्वासनों को सावधानी से लिया है, और गलियारे से गुजरने वाले यातायात में किसी भी व्यवधान पर नजर रखे हुए हैं।

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: खबरों के अनुसार हूती लड़ाके अब जलडमरूमध्य के अफ्रीकी हिस्से के करीब तैनात हैं, जो इस बात की याद दिलाता है कि समूह अब चोकपॉइंट के दृष्टिकोणों को कितनी मजबूती से जकड़े हुए है।

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## मानवीय लागत

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: यह अभियान यमनी नागरिकों के लिए भारी कीमत पर आया है।

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: सहायता अधिकारियों का कहना है कि लड़ाई के एक सप्ताह में कई सौ लोग मारे गए हैं और हजारों लोग अपने घरों से विस्थापित हो गए हैं, संयुक्त राष्ट्र की प्रवासन एजेंसी का अनुमान है कि हिंसा के कारण लगभग 46,000 लोग विस्थापित हुए हैं।

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: मानवीय समूह प्रभावित तटीय समुदायों तक पहुंच की अपील कर रहे हैं क्योंकि अग्रिम पंक्तियाँ बदल रही हैं।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, शिपिंग और ऊर्जा बाजार तेजी से प्रतिक्रिया करने के बजाय बारीकी से देख रहे हैं, क्योंकि क्षेत्रीय नियंत्रण में बदलाव के बावजूद बाब अल-मंडेब के माध्यम से जहाजों की आवाजाही जारी है।

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: लेकिन हूतियों के आश्वासनों की टिकाऊपन, खाड़ी देशों और पश्चिमी नौसेनाओं की प्रतिक्रिया, और व्यापक क्षेत्रीय संघर्ष का व्यापक प्रक्षेपवक्र संभवतः यह निर्धारित करेगा कि क्या यह ग्रह की सबसे व्यस्त व्यापारिक धमनियों में से एक पर नियंत्रण रखने वाले के रूप में एक स्थायी बदलाव बन जाता है — या लाल सागर के दक्षिणी द्वार के लिए एक लंबे संघर्ष का शुरुआती अध्याय।

es.title: Dos estrechos, un estrangulamiento: Cómo los hutíes tomaron el control de la ruta marítima de Bab el-Mandeb

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Una semana que rediseñó el mapa del mar Rojo

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: En el espacio de poco más de una semana, las fuerzas hutíes alineadas con Irán han completado una rápida campaña militar que las deja en control efectivo del lado yemení del estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, la estrecha vía fluvial que canaliza el tráfico marítimo entre el mar Rojo y el golfo de Adén, y desde allí hacia el canal de Suez.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: La ofensiva comenzó el 3 de septiembre con un impulso para cortar la carretera que une la ciudad de Taiz con el puerto de Moka.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: En cuestión de días, las unidades hutíes habían tomado Moka, la localidad de Dhubab y la estratégicamente ubicada isla de Mayyun, cerca de la boca del estrecho.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: Las fuerzas gubernamentales se retiraron entonces de la isla de Perim, el puesto avanzado que divide Bab el-Mandeb en sus dos canales navegables, entregando a los hutíes el control de ambos pasos.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: El grupo pasó a apoderarse de las islas Hanish Mayor y Menor más al norte, completando su dominio sobre los puntos de paso clave del estrecho.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa el estrecho

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab el-Mandeb es uno de los cuellos de botella marítimos más importantes del mundo, ya que transporta una parte significativa del tráfico que de otro modo transitaría por el canal de Suez, incluido un gran volumen de exportaciones de petróleo del Golfo con destino a Europa y más allá.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: El control de la costa yemení del estrecho otorga a los hutíes —y por extensión a sus patrocinadores en Teherán— influencia sobre las rutas marítimas de las que dependen las naciones del mar Rojo y las navieras globales.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Los analistas han señalado que el momento es especialmente significativo: los avances se producen mientras Irán mantiene la presión sobre el estrecho de Ormuz, el paso al otro lado de la península arábiga por el que se mueve una gran parte del petróleo marítimo mundial.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Juntos, ambos cuellos de botella otorgan a las fuerzas aliadas con Irán influencia sobre las rutas marítimas en ambos flancos de la península, un acontecimiento que ha inquietado tanto a los mercados energéticos como a los gobiernos regionales.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Garantías hutíes, inquietud regional

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Un alto oficial del buró político hutí intentó tranquilizar a las navieras internacionales y a los gobiernos regionales, afirmando que el grupo no representa "ningún peligro" para el tráfico de carga en el mar Rojo y que "la libertad de navegación y el comercio internacional en el mar Rojo y Bab al-Mandab son seguros y ordenados".

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Los estados vecinos y las aseguradoras marítimas han tratado hasta ahora esas garantías con cautela, vigilando cualquier posible interrupción en el tránsito a través del corredor.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Se informa que los combatientes hutíes se encuentran ahora posicionados cerca del lado africano del estrecho, un recordatorio de cuán firmemente el grupo controla ahora los accesos al cuello de botella.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## El costo humano

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: La campaña ha tenido un alto precio para los civiles yemeníes.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de ayuda humanitaria afirman que la semana de combates ha dejado varios cientos de muertos y ha obligado a decenas de miles de personas a huir de sus hogares, y la agencia de migración de la ONU estima que aproximadamente 46,000 personas han sido desplazadas por la violencia.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Los grupos humanitarios están pidiendo acceso a las comunidades costeras afectadas a medida que cambian las líneas del frente.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué viene a continuación

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Por ahora, los mercados de transporte marítimo y energía están observando de cerca en lugar de reaccionar bruscamente, ya que los movimientos de buques a través de Bab el-Mandeb continúan a pesar del cambio en el control territorial.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Pero la durabilidad de las garantías de los hutíes, la respuesta de los estados del Golfo y las armadas occidentales, y la trayectoria general del conflicto regional más amplio probablemente determinarán si esto se convierte en un cambio duradero en quién detenta la influencia sobre una de las arterias comerciales más transitadas del planeta, o en el capítulo inicial de una lucha más larga por la puerta sur del mar Rojo.

ar.title: مضيقان، اختناق واحد: كيف سيطر الحوثيون على ممر باب المندب الملاحي

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## أسبوع أعاد رسم خريطة البحر الأحمر

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: في غضون ما يزيد قليلاً عن أسبوع، أكملت قوات الحوثي المتحالفة مع إيران حملة عسكرية سريعة تتركها في سيطرة فعليّة على الجانب اليمني من مضيق باب المندب — الممر المائي الضيق الذي يمرر الشحن بين البحر الأحمر وخليج عدن، صعوداً إلى قناة السويس.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: بدأ الهجوم في 3 سبتمبر بدفع لقطع الطريق الذي يربط مدينة تعز بميناء المخا.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: في غضون أيام، سيطرت وحدات الحوثي على المخا، ومديرية ذوباب، وجزيرة ميون ذات الموقع الاستراتيجي بالقرب من مدخل المضيق.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: ثم انسحبت القوات الحكومية من جزيرة بريم، النقطة الأمامية التي تقسم باب المندب إلى قناتين قابلتين للملاحة، مما سلم الحوثيين القيادة على كلا الممرين.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: ومضت الجماعة لتستولي على جزيرتي حنيش الكبرى والصغرى شمالاً، لتستكمل بذلك سيطرتها على نقاط الطريق الرئيسية في المضيق.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا يكتسب المضيق أهمية

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: يُعد باب المندب أحد أكثر نقاط الاختناق البحرية أهمية في العالم، حيث ينقل نسبة كبيرة من حركة المرور التي كانت ستعبر بخلاف ذلك قناة السويس، بما في ذلك حجم كبير من صادرات النفط الخليجية المتجهة إلى أوروبا وما وراءها.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: تمنح السيطرة على الساحل اليمني للمضيق الحوثيين — ومن خلالهم داعميهم في طهران — نفوذاً على الممرات الملاحية التي تعتمد عليها دول البحر الأحمر والشركات الناقلة العالمية.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: أشار المحللون إلى أن توقيت ذلك حساس بشكل خاص: إذ تأتي المكاسب بينما تحافظ إيران على الضغط على مضيق هرمز، الممر الواقع على الجانب الآخر من شبه الجزيرة العربية والذي تمر عبره نسبة كبيرة من النفط المنقول بحراً في العالم.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: معاً، تمنح نقطتا الاختناق القوات المتحالفة مع إيران نفوذاً على الطرق البحرية على جانبي شبه الجزيرة، وهو تطور أثار قلق أسواق الطاقة والحكومات الإقليمية على حد سواء.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## تأكيدات الحوثيين، وقلق إقليمي

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: سعى مسؤول بارز في المكتب السياسي للحوثيين إلى طمأنة شركات الشحن الدولية والحكومات الإقليمية، قائلاً إن الجماعة لا تشكل "أي خطر" على حركة الشحن في البحر الأحمر وأن "حرية الملاحة والتجارة الدولية في البحر الأحمر وباب المندب آمنة ومنظمة."

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: تعاملت الدول المجاورة وشركات التأمين البحري حتى الآن بحذر مع هذه التأكيدات، مراقبةً أي اضطراب في حركة العبور عبر الممر.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: تفيد التقارير الآن أن مقاتلي الحوثي يتمركزون بالقرب من الجانب الأفريقي من المضيق، في تذكير بمدى إحكام سيطرة الجماعة الآن على مداخل نقطة الاختناق.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## الثمن البشري

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: تكبد المدنيون اليمنيون ثمناً باهظاً جراء هذه الحملة.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: يقول مسؤولون في مجال الإغاثة إن أسبوع القتال خلف عدة مئات من القتلى وأجبر عشرات الآلاف على ترك منازلهم، حيث تقدر وكالة الهجرة التابعة للأمم المتحدة أن حوالي 46000 شخص نزحوا بسبب العنف.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: تطالب الجماعات الإنسانية بالحصول على إمكانية الوصول إلى المجتمعات الساحلية المتضررة مع تغير خطوط المواجهة.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ما يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، تراقب أسواق الشحن والطاقة عن كثب بدلاً من رد الفعل الحاد، حيث تستمر حركة السفن عبر باب المندب على الرغم من التغيير في السيطرة الإقليمية.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: لكن متانة تأكيدات الحوثيين، واستجابة دول الخليج والقوات البحرية الغربية، والمسار الأوسع للصراع الإقليمي الأوسع ستحدد على الأرجح ما إذا كان هذا سيصبح تحولاً دائمماً فيمن يمتلك النفوذ على أحد أكثر شرايين التجارة ازدحاماً على كوكب الأرض - أم الفصل الافتتاحي لصراع أطول على البوابة الجنوبية للبحر الأحمر.

fr.title: Deux détroits, un goulet d'étranglement : Comment les Houthis ont pris le contrôle de la voie maritime de Bab el-Mandeb

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Une semaine qui a redessiné la carte de la mer Rouge

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: En l'espace d'un peu plus d'une semaine, les forces houthies alignées sur l'Iran ont achevé une campagne militaire rapide qui les laisse en contrôle effectif de la côte yéménite du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb — la voie navigable étroite qui canalise le trafic maritime entre la mer Rouge et le golfe d'Aden, et vers le canal de Suez.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: L'offensive a commencé le 3 septembre par une poussée visant à couper la route reliant la ville de Taiz au port de Mokha.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: En quelques jours, les unités houthies s'étaient emparées de Mokha, de la ville de Dhubab et de l'île stratégique de Mayyun près de l'embouchure du détroit.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: Les forces gouvernementales se sont ensuite retirées de l'île de Périm, l'avant-poste qui divise Bab el-Mandeb en ses deux canaux navigables, remettant aux Houthis le commandement des deux passages.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: Le groupe a ensuite saisi les îles Greater et Lesser Hanish plus au nord, parachevant son emprise sur les points de passage clés du détroit.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le détroit est important

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab el-Mandeb est l'un des points de passage maritime les plus importants au monde, transportant une part significative du trafic qui transiterait autrement par le canal de Suez, y compris un volume important d'exportations de pétrole du Golfe à destination de l'Europe et au-delà.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: Le contrôle du littoral yéménite du détroit donne aux Houthis — et par extension à leurs soutiens à Téhéran — un moyen de pression sur les voies de navigation dont dépendent les nations de la mer Rouge et les transporteurs mondiaux.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Les analystes ont noté que le timing est particulièrement ciblé : ces gains surviennent alors que l'Iran maintient la pression sur le détroit d'Ormuz, le passage de l'autre côté de la péninsule arabique par lequel transitent une grande partie des exportations de pétrole maritime mondial.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Ensemble, les deux points de passage confèrent aux forces alignées sur l'Iran une influence sur les routes maritimes des deux flancs de la péninsule, un développement qui a ébranlé les marchés de l'énergie et les gouvernements régionaux.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Assurances houthies, malaise régional

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Un haut responsable du bureau politique houthi a cherché à rassurer les entreprises de transport maritime internationales et les gouvernements régionaux, déclarant que le groupe ne représente "aucun danger" pour le trafic de marchandises en mer Rouge et que "la liberté de navigation et le commerce international en mer Rouge et à Bab al-Mandab sont sûrs et ordonnés."

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Les États voisins et les assureurs maritimes ont jusqu'à présent traité ces assurances avec prudence, guettant toute perturbation du transit par le corridor.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Des combattants houthis seraient maintenant positionnés près du côté africain du détroit, un rappel de la fermeté avec laquelle le groupe maîtrise désormais les approches du goulet d'étranglement.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## Le coût humain

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: La campagne a coûté cher aux civils yéménites.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Les responsables de l'aide humanitaire affirment que la semaine de combats a fait plusieurs centaines de morts et forcé des dizaines de milliers de personnes à quitter leur foyer, l'agence des migrations de l'ONU estimant à environ 46 000 le nombre de personnes déplacées par la violence.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Les groupes humanitaires appellent à l'accès aux communautés côtières touchées à mesure que les lignes de front se déplacent.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite ?

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les marchés du transport maritime et de l'énergie observent attentivement plutôt que de réagir brutalement, les mouvements de navires à travers Bab el-Mandeb se poursuivant malgré le changement de contrôle territorial.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Mais la durabilité des assurances des Houthis, la réaction des États du Golfe et des marines occidentales, ainsi que la trajectoire globale du conflit régional plus large détermineront probablement si cela devient un changement durable dans l'exercice du pouvoir sur l'une des artères commerciales les plus fréquentées de la planète — ou le premier chapitre d'une lutte plus longue pour la porte sud de la mer Rouge.

pt.title: Dois Estreitos, Um Gargalo: Como os Houthis Assumiram o Controle da Rota de Navegação de Bab el-Mandeb

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Uma Semana Que Redesenhou o Mapa do Mar Vermelho

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: No espaço de pouco mais de uma semana, as forças Houthi alinhadas ao Irã concluíram uma rápida campanha militar que as deixa no controle efetivo do lado iemenita do Estreito de Bab el-Mandeb — a estreita via marítima que canaliza a navegação entre o Mar Vermelho e o Golfo de Aden, e adiante para o Canal de Suez.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: A ofensiva começou em 3 de setembro com um esforço para cortar a estrada que liga a cidade de Taiz ao porto de Mokha.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: Em poucos dias, as unidades Houthi haviam tomado Mokha, a cidade de Dhubab e a estrategicamente posicionada ilha de Mayyun, perto da foz do estreito.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: As forças governamentais retiraram-se então da Ilha de Perim, o posto avançado que divide Bab el-Mandeb em seus dois canais navegáveis, entregando aos Houthis o comando de ambas as passagens.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: O grupo passou a tomar as ilhas Hanish Maior e Menor, mais ao norte, consolidando seu domínio sobre os pontos de passagem fundamentais do estreito.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Estreito Importa

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab el-Mandeb é um dos gargalos marítimos mais importantes do mundo, transportando uma parcela significativa do tráfego que, de outra forma, transitaria pelo Canal de Suez, incluindo um grande volume de exportações de petróleo do Golfo destinadas à Europa e além.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: O controle da costa iemenita do estreito dá aos Houthis — e, por extensão, aos seus apoiadores em Teerã — influência sobre as rotas de navegação das quais dependem as nações do Mar Vermelho e as transportadoras globais.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Analistas observaram que o momento é especialmente oportuno: os ganhos ocorrem enquanto o Irã mantém pressão sobre o Estreito de Ormuz, a passagem do outro lado da Península Arábica pela qual se move uma grande parte do petróleo transportado por via marítima no mundo.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Juntos, os dois gargalos dão às forças alinhadas ao Irã influência sobre as rotas marítimas em ambos os flancos da península, um desenvolvimento que tem inquietado tanto os mercados de energia quanto os governos regionais.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Garantias Houthi, Inquietação Regional

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Um alto funcionário do comitê político Houthi procurou tranquilizar as empresas de navegação internacional e os governos regionais, dizendo que o grupo não representa "nenhum perigo" para o tráfego de carga no Mar Vermelho e que "a liberdade de navegação e o comércio internacional no Mar Vermelho e em Bab al-Mandab estão seguros e ordenados".

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Os estados vizinhos e as seguradoras marítimas têm tratado essas garantias com cautela até o momento, observando qualquer interrupção no trânsito pelo corredor.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Relatos indicam que combatentes Houthi estão agora posicionados perto do lado africano do estreito, um lembrete de quão firmemente o grupo agora domina os acessos ao gargalo.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## O Custo Humano

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: A campanha teve um preço alto para os civis iemenitas.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Autoridades de ajuda humanitária dizem que a semana de combates deixou várias centenas de mortos e forçou dezenas de milhares a abandonarem suas casas, com a agência de migração da ONU estimando cerca de 46.000 pessoas deslocadas pela violência.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Grupos humanitários estão apelando por acesso às comunidades costeiras afetadas à medida que as linhas de frente se movem.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem a Seguir

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, os mercados de navegação e energia estão observando de perto em vez de reagir bruscamente, já que os movimentos de embarcações por Bab el-Mandeb continuam apesar da mudança no controle territorial.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Mas a durabilidade das garantias dos Houthis, a resposta dos estados do Golfo e das marinhas ocidentais, e a trajetória mais ampla do conflito regional provavelmente determinarão se isso se tornará uma mudança duradoura sobre quem detém a influência em uma das artérias comerciais mais movimentadas do planeta — ou o capítulo de abertura de uma luta mais longa pelo portão sul do Mar Vermelho.

in.title: Dua Selat, Satu Cekikan: Bagaimana Houthi Menguasai Jalur Pelayaran Bab el-Mandeb

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Seminggu yang Menggambar Ulang Peta Laut Merah

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: Dalam rentang waktu sedikit lebih dari seminggu, pasukan Houthi yang bersekutu dengan Iran telah menyelesaikan kampanye militer cepat yang membuat mereka secara efektif menguasai sisi Yaman dari Selat Bab el-Mandeb — jalur air sempit yang menyalurkan pelayaran antara Laut Merah dan Teluk Aden, serta terus menuju Terusan Suez.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: Serangan dimulai pada 3 September dengan upaya untuk memutus jalan yang menghubungkan kota Taiz ke pelabuhan Mokha.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa hari, unit-unit Houthi telah merebut Mokha, kota Dhubab, dan pulau Mayyun yang berlokasi strategis di dekat mulut selat tersebut.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: Pasukan pemerintah kemudian mundur dari Pulau Perim, pos terdepan yang membagi Bab el-Mandeb menjadi dua saluran yang dapat dilayari, menyerahkan kendali kedua jalur tersebut kepada Houthi.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: Kelompok tersebut kemudian merebut pulau Greater dan Lesser Hanish lebih jauh ke utara, melengkapi cengkeraman mereka pada titik-titik penting selat tersebut.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Selat Ini Penting

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab el-Mandeb adalah salah satu titik sempit maritim paling penting di dunia, yang membawa sebagian besar lalu lintas yang seharusnya melewati Terusan Suez, termasuk volume besar ekspor minyak Teluk yang ditujukan ke Eropa dan sekitarnya.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: Kendali atas garis pantai Yaman di selat tersebut memberikan Houthi — dan secara tidak langsung pendukung mereka di Teheran — pengaruh atas jalur pelayaran yang diandalkan oleh negara-negara Laut Merah dan operator pelayaran global.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa waktunya sangat tepat: keuntungan ini datang saat Iran mempertahankan tekanan pada Selat Hormuz, jalur di sisi lain Semenanjung Arab yang melaluinya sebagian besar minyak laut dunia bergerak.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Bersama-sama, kedua titik sempit tersebut memberikan pasukan yang bersekutu dengan Iran pengaruh atas rute maritim di kedua sisi semenanjung, sebuah perkembangan yang telah membuat pasar energi dan pemerintah regional merasa tidak tenang.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Jaminan Houthi, Kecemasan Regional

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Seorang pejabat senior politbiro Houthi berusaha meyakinkan perusahaan pelayaran internasional dan pemerintah regional, dengan mengatakan bahwa kelompok tersebut tidak menimbulkan "bahaya" bagi lalu lintas kargo Laut Merah dan bahwa "kebebasan navigasi dan perdagangan internasional di Laut Merah dan Bab al-Mandab aman dan tertib."

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Negara-negara tetangga dan penanggung asuransi pelayaran sejauh ini menanggapi jaminan tersebut dengan hati-hati, sambil mengawasi setiap gangguan terhadap transit melalui koridor tersebut.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Pejuang Houthi sekarang dilaporkan berada di dekat sisi Afrika dari selat tersebut, sebuah pengingat betapa eratnya kelompok tersebut sekarang mencengkeram pendekatan ke titik sempit itu.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## Biaya Kemanusiaan

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: Kampanye ini harus dibayar mahal oleh warga sipil Yaman.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Pejabat bantuan mengatakan seminggu pertempuran telah menyebabkan beberapa ratus orang tewas dan memaksa puluhan ribu orang meninggalkan rumah mereka, dengan badan migrasi PBB memperkirakan sekitar 46.000 orang mengungsi akibat kekerasan tersebut.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Kelompok kemanusiaan meminta akses ke komunitas pesisir yang terdampak seiring bergesernya garis depan.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, pasar pelayaran dan energi mengawasi dengan cermat daripada bereaksi tajam, karena pergerakan kapal melalui Bab el-Mandeb terus berlanjut meskipun terjadi perubahan dalam kendali wilayah.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Namun, ketahanan jaminan Houthi, respons dari negara-negara Teluk dan angkatan laut Barat, serta lintasan yang lebih luas dari konflik regional yang lebih besar kemungkinan akan menentukan apakah ini menjadi pergeseran abadi dalam siapa yang memegang pengaruh atas salah satu arteri perdagangan tersibuk di planet ini — atau bab pembuka dari perjuangan yang lebih panjang untuk gerbang selatan Laut Merah.

ja.title: 2つの海峡、1つのチョークポイント：フーシ派はいかにしてバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡の支配権を握ったか

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## 紅海の地図を塗り替えた1週間

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: わずか1週間余りの間に、イランと連携するフーシ派勢力は急速な軍事作戦を完了させ、バブ・エル・マンデブ海峡のイエメン側を実質的に支配下に置いた。この海峡は、紅海とアデン湾、そしてその先のスエズ運河を結ぶ物流の要衝である。

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: 攻勢は9月3日、タイズ市とモカ港を結ぶ道路を遮断する動きから始まった。

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: 数日のうちに、フーシ派部隊はモカ、ドゥバブの町、そして海峡の入り口近くにある戦略的に重要なマイユン島を占領した。

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: その後、政府軍はバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡を2つの航行可能な水路に分断する前哨基地であるペリム島から撤退し、フーシ派に両方の水路の指揮権を明け渡した。

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: 同グループはさらに北にある大ハニシュ島と小ハニシュ島も占領し、海峡の主要な拠点を完全に掌握した。

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## なぜ海峡が重要なのか

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: バブ・エル・マンデブ海峡は世界で最も重要な海上チョークポイントの一つであり、スエズ運河を通過する交通量のかなりの部分を担っている。これには、ヨーロッパやその先へ向かう湾岸諸国の石油輸出の大部分が含まれる。

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: 海峡のイエメン側の海岸線を支配することは、フーシ派、ひいてはテヘランの支援者たちに、紅海沿岸諸国や世界の海運業者が依存する航路に対する影響力を与えることになる。

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: アナリストたちは、このタイミングが特に際立っていると指摘している。この利得は、イランがアラビア半島の反対側にあるホルムズ海峡に対して圧力を維持している中で得られたものだからだ。ホルムズ海峡は、世界の海上石油輸送の大部分が通過する場所である。

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: この2つのチョークポイントを合わせることで、イランと連携する勢力は半島両側の海上ルートに影響力を持つことになり、この展開はエネルギー市場と地域政府の双方を不安にさせている。

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## フーシ派の保証と地域の不安

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: フーシ派政治局の高官は、国際的な海運会社や地域政府を安心させようと、同グループは紅海の貨物輸送に「何の危険」も及ぼさないとし、「紅海およびバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡における航行の自由と国際貿易は安全かつ秩序あるものだ」と述べた。

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: 近隣諸国や海上保険会社は今のところ、これらの保証を慎重に受け止めており、回廊を通る輸送に混乱が生じないか注視している。

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: フーシ派の戦闘員は現在、海峡のアフリカ側に近い場所に配置されていると報告されており、同グループがいかに強力にこのチョークポイントへの入り口を掌握しているかを物語っている。

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## 人道的犠牲

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: この軍事作戦は、イエメンの民間人に大きな犠牲を強いた。

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: 援助関係者によると、1週間の戦闘で数百人が死亡し、数万人が家を追われた。国連の移住機関は、暴力によって約46,000人が避難を余儀なくされたと推定している。

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: 人道支援団体は、前線が移動する中で、影響を受けた沿岸地域へのアクセスを求めている。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: 今のところ、領土支配の変化にもかかわらずバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡を通る船舶の移動は続いているため、海運・エネルギー市場は急激な反応を示すのではなく、注視している状態である。

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: しかし、フーシ派による保証がどれだけ持続するか、湾岸諸国や西側海軍がどう対応するか、そしてより広範な地域紛争の軌跡がどうなるかによって、これが地球上で最も忙しい貿易動脈の一つに対する支配権の永続的な変化となるのか、それとも紅海の南の門をめぐるより長い闘争の序章となるのかが決まるだろう。

de.title: Zwei Meerengen, ein Würgegriff: Wie die Huthi die Kontrolle über die Schifffahrtsstraße Bab al-Mandab übernahmen

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Eine Woche, die die Karte des Roten Meeres neu zeichnete

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: Innerhalb von kaum mehr als einer Woche haben die mit dem Iran verbündeten Huthi-Kräfte eine rasche Militäroffensive abgeschlossen, die ihnen die effektive Kontrolle über die jemenitische Seite der Meerenge Bab al-Mandab verschafft hat – die schmale Wasserstraße, die den Schiffsverkehr zwischen dem Roten Meer und dem Golf von Aden sowie weiter zum Suezkanal leitet.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: Die Offensive begann am 3. September mit dem Vorstoß, die Straße zwischen der Stadt Taiz und dem Hafen von Mocha zu unterbrechen.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: Innerhalb weniger Tage hatten Huthi-Einheiten Mocha, die Stadt Dhubab und die strategisch günstig gelegene Insel Mayyun nahe der Mündung der Meerenge eingenommen.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: Regierungstruppen zogen sich daraufhin von der Insel Perim zurück, dem Außenposten, der Bab al-Mandab in seine zwei schiffbaren Kanäle teilt, und überließen den Huthi die Kontrolle über beide Passagen.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: Die Gruppe eroberte anschließend die weiter nördlich gelegenen Inseln Groß- und Klein-Hanish und rundete damit ihre Kontrolle über die wichtigsten Wegpunkte der Meerenge ab.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum die Meerenge wichtig ist

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab al-Mandab ist einer der bedeutendsten maritimen Engpässe der Welt und bewältigt einen erheblichen Teil des Verkehrs, der ansonsten den Suezkanal passieren würde, einschließlich einer großen Menge an Ölexporten aus dem Golf, die für Europa und darüber hinaus bestimmt sind.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: Die Kontrolle über die jemenitische Küstenlinie der Meerenge gibt den Huthi – und damit auch ihren Unterstützern in Teheran – Einfluss auf die Schifffahrtsrouten, von denen die Anrainerstaaten des Roten Meeres und globale Reedereien abhängig sind.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Analysten haben darauf hingewiesen, dass das Timing besonders gezielt ist: Die Gewinne kommen zu einem Zeitpunkt, an dem der Iran den Druck auf die Straße von Hormus aufrechterhält, die Passage auf der anderen Seite der Arabischen Halbinsel, durch die ein großer Teil des weltweiten Öltransports auf dem Seeweg fließt.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Zusammen verleihen die beiden Engpässe den mit dem Iran verbündeten Kräften Einfluss auf die maritimen Routen an beiden Flanken der Halbinsel, eine Entwicklung, die sowohl die Energiemärkte als auch die regionalen Regierungen beunruhigt hat.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Zusicherungen der Huthi, regionale Unruhe

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Ein hochrangiger Funktionär des Huthi-Politbüros versuchte, internationale Reedereien und regionale Regierungen zu beruhigen, indem er sagte, die Gruppe stelle "keine Gefahr" für den Frachtverkehr im Roten Meer dar und dass "die Freiheit der Schifffahrt und der internationale Handel im Roten Meer und Bab al-Mandab sicher und geordnet" seien.

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Benachbarte Staaten und Schiffsversicherer haben diese Zusicherungen bisher vorsichtig behandelt und beobachten aufmerksam, ob es zu Störungen des Transits durch den Korridor kommt.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Berichten zufolge haben sich Huthi-Kämpfer nun in der Nähe der afrikanischen Seite der Meerenge positioniert, was daran erinnert, wie fest die Gruppe den Engpass nun im Griff hat.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## Die menschlichen Kosten

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: Die Kampagne hat für die jemenitische Zivilbevölkerung einen hohen Preis gefordert.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Hilfsorganisationen berichten, dass die einwöchigen Kämpfe mehrere hundert Menschen das Leben gekostet und Zehntausende aus ihren Häusern vertrieben haben, wobei die Migrationsbehörde der UN schätzt, dass etwa 46.000 Menschen durch die Gewalt vertrieben wurden.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Humanitäre Gruppen fordern Zugang zu den betroffenen Küstengemeinden, während sich die Frontlinien verschieben.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Vorerst beobachten die Schifffahrts- und Energiemärkte die Lage genau, anstatt scharf zu reagieren, da sich Schiffe trotz des Wechsels der territorialen Kontrolle weiterhin durch Bab al-Mandab bewegen.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Doch die Beständigkeit der Zusicherungen der Huthi, die Reaktion der Golfstaaten und westlicher Marinen sowie der weitere Verlauf des regionalen Konflikts werden wahrscheinlich darüber entscheiden, ob dies eine dauerhafte Verschiebung der Machtverhältnisse über eine der verkehrsreichsten Handelsadern des Planeten darstellt – oder das erste Kapitel eines längeren Kampfes um das südliche Tor zum Roten Meer.

vi.title: Hai Eo biển, Một Nút thắt cổ chai: Cách lực lượng Houthi Giám quyền Kiểm soát Tuyến hàng hải Bab el-Mandeb

segments.src: ## A Week That Redrew the Red Sea's Map
segments.tr: ## Một Tuần Thay Đổi Bản Đồ Biển Đỏ

segments.src: In the span of little more than a week, Iran-aligned Houthi forces have completed a rapid military campaign that leaves them in effective control of the Yemeni side of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait — the narrow waterway that funnels shipping between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, and onward to the Suez Canal.
segments.tr: Chỉ trong vòng hơn một tuần, lực lượng Houthi thân Iran đã hoàn thành một chiến dịch quân sự chớp nhoáng, nắm quyền kiểm soát thực tế bờ biển Yemen thuộc Eo biển Bab el-Mandeb — tuyến đường thủy hẹp dồn các tàu bè qua lại giữa Biển Đỏ và Vịnh Aden, tiếp tục hướng tới Kênh đào Suez.

segments.src: The offensive began on September 3 with a push to sever the road linking the city of Taiz to the port of Mokha.
segments.tr: Cuộc tấn công bắt đầu vào ngày 3 tháng 9 với nỗ lực cắt đứt con đường nối thành phố Taiz với cảng Mokha.

segments.src: Within days, Houthi units had taken Mokha, the town of Dhubab, and the strategically placed island of Mayyun near the strait's mouth.
segments.tr: Trong vòng vài ngày, các đơn vị Houthi đã chiếm được Mokha, thị trấn Dhubab, và hòn đảo có vị trí chiến lược Mayyun gần cửa eo biển.

segments.src: Government forces then withdrew from Perim Island, the outpost that splits Bab el-Mandeb into its two navigable channels, handing the Houthis command of both passages.
segments.tr: Lực lượng chính phủ sau đó đã rút khỏi Đảo Perim, tiền đồn chia cắt Bab el-Mandeb thành hai luồng hàng hải, trao cho Houthi quyền chỉ huy cả hai lối đi.

segments.src: The group went on to seize the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands further north, rounding out its hold on the strait's key waypoints.
segments.tr: Nhóm này tiếp tục chiếm các đảo Greater và Lesser Hanish xa hơn về phía bắc, hoàn thiện quyền kiểm soát các điểm mấu chốt của eo biển.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao Eo biển lại Quan trọng

segments.src: Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most consequential maritime chokepoints, carrying a significant share of the traffic that would otherwise transit the Suez Canal, including a large volume of Gulf oil exports bound for Europe and beyond.
segments.tr: Bab el-Mandeb là một trong những nút thắt hàng hải quan trọng nhất thế giới, gánh vác phần lớn lượng giao thông lẽ ra sẽ đi qua Kênh đào Suez, bao gồm khối lượng lớn xuất khẩu dầu của Vịnh hướng tới Châu Âu và xa hơn nữa.

segments.src: Control of the strait's Yemeni shoreline gives the Houthis — and by extension their backers in Tehran — leverage over shipping lanes that Red Sea nations and global carriers depend on.
segments.tr: Việc kiểm soát bờ biển Yemen của eo biển mang lại cho Houthi — và rộng ra là những người hậu thuẫn họ ở Tehran — đòn bẩy đối với các tuyến vận tải biển mà các quốc gia Biển Đỏ và các hãng vận tải toàn cầu phụ thuộc vào.

segments.src: Analysts have noted the timing is especially pointed: the gains come as Iran maintains pressure on the Strait of Hormuz, the passage on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil moves.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích đã lưu ý rằng thời điểm diễn ra sự việc rất đáng chú ý: các lợi thế đạt được khi Iran duy trì áp lực lên Eo biển Hormuz, lối đi ở phía bên kia Bán đảo Ả Rập nơi phần lớn lượng dầu vận chuyển bằng đường biển của thế giới đi qua.

segments.src: Together, the two chokepoints give Iran-aligned forces influence over maritime routes on both flanks of the peninsula, a development that has unsettled energy markets and regional governments alike.
segments.tr: Cùng nhau, hai nút thắt cổ chai mang lại cho lực lượng liên minh với Iran ảnh hưởng đối với các tuyến đường hàng hải ở cả hai sườn của bán đảo, một diễn biến đã làm lu mờ thị trường năng lượng và các chính phủ khu vực.

segments.src: ## Houthi Assurances, Regional Unease
segments.tr: ## Sự Trấn an của Houthi, Sự Bất an của Khu vực

segments.src: A senior Houthi politburo official sought to reassure international shipping firms and regional governments, saying the group poses "no danger" to Red Sea cargo traffic and that "freedom of navigation and international trade in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab are safe and orderly."
segments.tr: Một quan chức cấp cao của bộ chính trị Houthi đã tìm cách trấn an các công ty vận tải biển quốc tế và các chính phủ khu vực, nói rằng nhóm này không gây ra "mối nguy hiểm" nào đối với lưu lượng hàng hóa Biển Đỏ và rằng "tự do hàng hải và thương mại quốc tế ở Biển Đỏ và Bab al-Mandab vẫn an toàn và có trật tự."

segments.src: Neighboring states and shipping insurers have so far treated those assurances cautiously, watching for any disruption to transit through the corridor.
segments.tr: Các quốc gia láng giềng và các hãng bảo hiểm hàng hải cho đến nay vẫn đối xử thận trọng với những sự đảm bảo đó, theo dõi mọi sự gián đoạn đối với việc quá cảnh qua hành lang này.

segments.src: Houthi fighters are now reported to be positioned close to the African side of the strait, a reminder of how tightly the group now grips the chokepoint's approaches.
segments.tr: Các tay súng Houthi hiện được cho là đang đồn trú gần bờ biển Châu Phi của eo biển, một lời nhắc nhở về việc nhóm này nắm giữ chặt chẽ các lối tiếp cận của nút thắt cổ chai đến nhường nào.

segments.src: ## The Human Cost
segments.tr: ## Cái Giá Con Người

segments.src: The campaign has come at a heavy price for Yemeni civilians.
segments.tr: Chiến dịch này đã để lại cái giá rất đắt cho thường dân Yemen.

segments.src: Aid officials say the week of fighting has left several hundred people dead and forced tens of thousands from their homes, with the UN's migration agency estimating roughly 46,000 people displaced by the violence.
segments.tr: Các quan chức viện trợ cho biết tuần giao tranh đã khiến vài trăm người thiệt mạng và buộc hàng chục nghìn người phải rời bỏ nhà cửa, với cơ quan di cư của Liên Hợp Quốc ước tính có khoảng 46.000 người phải di dời do bạo lực.

segments.src: Humanitarian groups are appealing for access to affected coastal communities as the front lines shift.
segments.tr: Các nhóm nhân đạo đang kêu gọi quyền tiếp cận các cộng đồng ven biển bị ảnh hưởng khi các chiến tuyến dịch chuyển.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Chuyện Gì Sẽ Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: For now, shipping and energy markets are watching closely rather than reacting sharply, as vessel movements through Bab el-Mandeb continue despite the change in territorial control.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, thị trường vận tải biển và năng lượng đang theo dõi chặt chẽ thay vì phản ứng mạnh mẽ, khi các chuyển động của tàu qua Bab el-Mandeb vẫn tiếp tục bất chấp sự thay đổi về quyền kiểm soát lãnh thổ.

segments.src: But the durability of the Houthis' assurances, the response from Gulf states and Western navies, and the broader trajectory of the wider regional conflict will likely determine whether this becomes a lasting shift in who holds leverage over one of the planet's busiest trade arteries — or the opening chapter of a longer struggle for the Red Sea's southern gate.
segments.tr: Nhưng tính bền vững của các cam kết từ Houthi, phản ứng từ các quốc gia vùng Vịnh và hải quân phương Tây, cùng quỹ đạo rộng lớn hơn của xung đột khu vực rộng lớn hơn có khả năng sẽ quyết định liệu đây có trở thành một sự thay đổi lâu dài về ai nắm giữ đòn bẩy đối với một trong những huyết mạch thương mại bận rộn nhất hành tinh — hay là chương mở đầu cho một cuộc đấu tranh dài hơn cho cửa ngõ phía nam của Biển Đỏ.
